html:
The Moonsilver Set consists of the best equipment in the game released with the Summer Update 2026. The set consists of helmets and weapons for each vocation.

All of the regular items can be obtained from the Make Believe Quest, only through the drop of the bosses in the quest. The weapons have a special version called Stellar Moonsilver, which have stronger stats, but can not be dropped. Once the The Stellar can only be obtained by crafting it.

Obtaining Stellar Moonsilver

In order to craft one Stellar weapon, a character must have completed the Make Believe Quest and gained access to Wayland Smythers in the Radiant Skyhold. Tell Wayland you want to craft. This process requires materials to consume, and the character must have the items in the backpack to deliver:

  • 3x weapons of the same type; one from the Soul Set, one from the Sanguine, and one from the Moonsilver Set. None of them can have tiers.
  • 1x Auric Moon Sigil

For example, to craft 1x Stellar Moonsilver Bow, a character would have to deliver 1x Auric Moon Sigil, 1x T0 Soulbleeder, 1x T0 Sanguine Bow, and 1x T0 Moonsilver Bow.
